team.subtitle: We are a group of enthusiastic researchers dedicated to exploring the interactions between biology and the environment.
team.pi_bio: I’m a behavioural ecologist, broadly interested in how biodiversity arises and persists in a rapidly changing world. Particularly, I am interested in the biotic responses to environmental changes and the importance of biodiversity to ecosystem functioning.

courses.title: Courses Offered
courses.subtitle: Combining building physics theory with data science practice to cultivate interdisciplinary net-zero building professionals.
courses.c1_title: Introduction to Net Zero Buildings and Simulation Practice
courses.c1_overview_desc: One of the main sources of global energy consumption is the building sector. To pursue the global net-zero emission goal, this course discusses the net-zero concept for buildings and incorporates real-world case studies for practical exercises. The course systematically deconstructs building physical environments and electromechanical systems, equipping students with core capabilities to analyze causes of building energy consumption. Using EnergyPlus for quantitative analysis.
courses.c1_obj_1: Build Core Knowledge: Master building physics (heat, light, air) and systems (HVAC, lighting).
courses.c1_obj_2: Master Simulation Tools: Proficient in EnergyPlus, geometry modeling, and parameter setting.
courses.c1_obj_3: Execute Field Survey: Field measurements of NTU campus buildings.
courses.c1_obj_4: Data Analysis & Calibration: Compare simulation with meter data and calibrate parameters.
courses.phase_1: Phase 1: Building Physics & Net Zero Basics
courses.prereq_desc: Basic data analysis skills (Excel or Python) recommended.
courses.c2_title: Data Science for Environment and Energy
courses.c2_overview_desc: Data-driven decision making plays a key role in environmental sustainability. This course aims to build students' data science foundation and explore applications in environmental monitoring and energy systems. Systematically teaching Python using Colaboratory, analyzing real-world campus data (smart meters, CO2, temperature).
courses.c2_obj_1: Master Data Processing: Python for cleaning and transformation.
courses.c2_obj_2: Master Analysis & Visualization: Pandas & Matplotlib/Seaborn for EDA.
courses.c2_obj_3: Build Prediction Models: Regression/Clustering for energy consumption.
courses.c2_obj_4: Solve Real Problems: Apply to campus cases.
